units.rationale: Journey groups 1 scenario with ordering [] and sharedState audio-only-fixtures-ready (fixture-set.audio-only@2) produced by preparation:audio-only-fixtures at Regression/preparations/audio-only-fixtures.md:147 with dependsOnTags app.session, fixture.corpus, lane.instance, library.contents, settings.state. Empty ordering is correct, no MainGate join, and lane device is declared for the audio-only corpus; runtime rebuilds Preparation when tag invalid, so no ordering defect.

Scenario has lane device, 2 staticCases audio-menu and speed-menu each with separate producer diagnostics.surface-probe@1 (adapter 2856) calls 07 and 14 with cursorToken from prior probe 05/12, relatedResults inlining tappedIdentifiers, response and assertAbsentObservations from accessibility.activate@2 (2725) call 06/13, and settleDelayMillis 9000. Activate@2 drives real tapSequence of PlayerUI-window-playback-surface, PlayerUI-TopAction-more, PlayerUI-menu-audio/speed in one controller round trip (validated at regression_operation_adapter.py:2725), not an injected commandReturnValue. Probe handler returns interactionTrace with reachability top actions delivered action=menu.more and secondary menu visible=true menu=more (WindowPlayerDeck.swift:438-441,525) which sets isControlsFocused via reportPresentation, and diagnostics handler at 2856 emits window.control-plane with mediaKind audioOnly, lifecycle Playing, controls shown after 9000ms settle exceeding 8s window from preparation call 02 controlsAutoHideSeconds 8. Fixture audio-only-aac-stereo-181s.m4a is generated-audio-only-aac-stereo-181s-v1 at fixture-registry.json with videoCodec none and regressionSets audio-only, so mediaKind audioOnly is genuine and PlayerInfoBarView.swift:41 removal of PlaybackTopActions does not remove More menu, while assertAbsentObservations are application-wide readings that can see system popover rows. Each obligation binds distinct surface-probe artifact per oracle:agent-structured-window-control-plane@1, success.all conjoins them, criteria are per-case lookups on relatedResults[0] ordered list, relatedResults[1] tapSequence response, interactionTrace lines and assertAbsentObservations exists false for videoFormat/dock/resumePanorama and isEnabled false for subtitles (DeckMenuItem always carries Off entry). Negative controls forbid split route, controller-only success without trace line, video mediaKind, controls hidden, or enabled subtitles, all decidable on one artifact with thresholds named (9000ms vs 8000ms).
